remarks:
This spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers plenty of room to make your own. The first floor features a large kitchen with ample space for cooking and gathering, a convenient first-floor laundry room, and a generously sized living room and dining room combination—perfect for entertaining or everyday living.

Upstairs, you’ll find 3 bedrooms along with a full bath. Outside, the property offers excellent parking and storage with a 1+ car detached garage located on Columbus Street, plus concrete driveways on both Deer Street and Columbus Street. Fully fenced in yard.

With its spacious interior, practical first-floor amenities, and multiple off-street parking options, 517 Deer Street is a great opportunity for a homeowner or investor looking to buy in Dunkirk. Come see the possibilities this home has to offer! For sale to settle an estate, home sold as is.
